source: .claude/skills/telugu-jyotisha/reference.md conventions; ayana by sidereal sankranti (Telugu almanac practice — 'standard', verify). Telugu labels from design/handoff.
notes: ayana: uttarayana while the Sun's sidereal rasi is one of uttarayanaRasis (Makara sankranti → Karkataka sankranti), else dakshinayana. paksha: tithi 1–15 shukla, 16–30 krishna. Krishna paksham has no human-written Telugu yet (the earlier value was composed by analogy, so it was removed).
